# `/criteria` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /criteria/v1/privilege

`createCustomPrivilegeCriteriaV1` — Create custom privilege criteria

Use this API to create a custom privilege criteria

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createprivilegecriteriarequest
- Returns 201: privilegecriteriadto

### GET /criteria/v1/privilege

`listPrivilegeCriteriaV1` — List privilege criteria

Use this API to list all privilege criteria matching a filter

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query, required) — fields: type: eq; sourceId: eq; privilegeLevel: eq — e.g. `type eq "CUSTOM" and sourceId eq "c42c45d8d7c04d2da64d215cd8c32f21"`
- Returns 200: array of privilegecriteriadto

### PUT /criteria/v1/privilege/{criteriaId}

`putCustomPrivilegeCriteriaValueV1` — Update privilege criteria

Use this API to update a specific custom privilege criteria by overwriting the information with new information.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `criteriaId` (path, required) — The Id of the privilege criteria record to return.
- Body (application/json): privilegecriteriadto
- Returns 200: privilegecriteriadto

### GET /criteria/v1/privilege/{criteriaId}

`getPrivilegeCriteriaV1` — Get privilege criteria

Use this API to get a specific privilege criteria.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `criteriaId` (path, required) — The Id of the privilege criteria record to return.
- Returns 200: privilegecriteriadto

### DELETE /criteria/v1/privilege/{criteriaId}

`deleteCustomPrivilegeCriteriaV1` — Delete privilege criteria

Use this API to delete a specific custom privilege criteria.

- Scopes: sp:gov-criteria:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `criteriaId` (path, required) — The Id of the custom privilege criteria to delete.
- Returns 204: no body
